description: Crowding / positioning data (market-intelligence F5/P7). Every name in this book is consensus-long; the dominant non-fundamental risk is that everyone owns the same AI names and leaves together -- a STATE, not a covariance, so Σ cannot represent it. Verified free source: FINRA consolidated short interest (twice-monthly, days-to-cover per name). NOTE: CFTC COT is unreachable (§8 item 2 / §11.5 gate 2) and is dropped; the 13F holder-concentration leg is a possible follow-on. The #6 SMH position is a SHORT, so a crowded SMH short is squeeze risk -- an upside tail a long-book stress framework will never flag. See design §2/§5 FINDING 5.

finra_short_interest.description: Twice-monthly consolidated short interest per symbol: current short position, average daily volume, and days-to-cover (short position / ADV) -- the direct crowding + squeeze-risk metric. Free JSON/CSV API, no key (POST query).
